application_type_full: Householder planning & demolition in a conservation area
description: Erection of a rear infill extension to the house
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The size, scale and positioning of the proposed rear infill extension would result in an increased sense of overbearingness and overshadowing that would harm the living conditions of neighbouring properties. The proposed development would therefore be contrary to Local Plan Policies CC1 (Context and Character), CC2 (Urban Design and Architecture) and SC7 (Residential Extensions and Alterations), and the intent of the Residential Extension Guidelines.

Condition : 2 - The size and scale of the proposed rear infill extension would be excessive and not be subservient to the host dwelling and so would harm the appearance of the site and surrounding area. The proposed development would therefore be contrary to Local Plan Policies SC7 (Residential Extensions and Alterations), CC1 (Context and Character), CC2 (Urban Design and Architecture) and CC4 (Heritage), and the intent of the Residential Extension Guidelines.
